<thought>Using the functional group names from the list, I will search for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic hydroxyl group while forming a C‑C double bond. This should retrieve the Peterson reaction template needed for the route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC[Si](C)(C)C", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
